description: Return the published overview for this GoVisit place, including its published classifications with scheme, recipient, validity and available evidence, and its operating status: operatingStatus.code is operational, temporarily_closed or permanently_closed, and null when the status is unknown. Operating status says whether the place still operates, not whether it is open right now. The result excludes place spatial details, which are available from the Location section, and includes freshness metadata from the page snapshot. Owner, chain and operator are organization names, each null when unknown; operator identifies the company managing the facility, distinct from profile management.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

name: get_place_overview

outputSchema.description: Successful read of the sanitized published page snapshot. Unsupported sections reject the invocation.

address.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

addresses.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

classifications.description: Current page-published classifications. Scheme codes define numeric scales; evidence is the exact linked page assessment or null, never inferred from a certificate URL.
